title: HandoffStatus
description: Machine-readable state for a Claude<->Codex handoff package.

task_id.description: Matches task_id in the corresponding ai/tasks/ record.

worktree_branch.description: Git branch created for this handoff. Set by orchestrator.

worktree_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the git worktree. Set by orchestrator.

planning_owner.description: Agent that produced the execution brief.

review_owner.description: Agent responsible for review and approval.

change.description: Path to ai/changes/<task-id>.md. Set after Codex completes.

validation.description: Path to ai/validation/<task-id>.md. Set after Codex completes.

review_brief.description: Path to ai/handoffs/<task-id>/review-brief.md. Set after Codex completes.
